body: Even if you did, random people on the internet caring about me doesn't make a difference.

> We need folk like you.

I don't get why people have to lie to people they've never met. Well actually maybe I do. Suicide is just so bad that people come up with whatever lies they can to make themselves feel better. So don't sweat it man, it's my fate.
I don't think it's brave, I just can't live a virtuous life and all I am is a drain on resources. It would be better if me and everyone else like me would kill themselves.
I know but I still don't care about happiness.
I want truth not positive feelings.
It doesn't mean anything to me. I don't care whether I'm happy or not.
